description: Monthly price ranges, protocol support, coverage and official registration links for 23 proxy IP providers serving the Chinese market.
disclaimer: Prices are starting points and ranges compiled from provider-published price sheets and reflect data verified as of 2026-10-03. Providers adjust pricing and promotions frequently. Always confirm the current price on the provider official page before purchase. Free trials are offered by most listed providers (优享云IP is the exception — a low-cost day card is available instead). Official registration links include referral / invitation codes: using them costs the buyer nothing extra and supports maintenance of this dataset.

All 23 price_page_url and all 23 registration links re-checked (23/23 HTTP 200 on both, 0 broken).
